title: policy-grounded guidance: charge after cancellation is eligible for a billing review (60 days); no refund promised
customerSaid: My email is jordan.reyes@customer.example and my account number is NF-100234.
agentReply: I see that you are asking about the next steps for reviewing the charge you received after your cancellation. Since you have provided your account information, I can let you know that charges posted after a cancellation request are eligible for a billing review. To proceed, please confirm whether you would like to open a billing review for this charge. Once confirmed, a billing review will be submitted for the billing team to examine, which normally takes up to 5 business days for a decision.
